resources.string: Remote login is available only for your own Windows devices.
The computer has not provided a verified RDP identity. Update its Calabi service and enable Remote Desktop.
Select a Windows device that supports Remote Desktop hosting.
Windows sign-in failed. Check the username, domain and account password (not a PIN).
Windows refused this account. Check Remote Desktop permissions, password expiry and account restrictions on the computer.
Could not reach Remote Desktop. Check the mesh, the computer and TCP 3389. Windows Home cannot host system RDP.
The remote connection ended. You can reconnect.
Plain text is transferred only when you press a button. Send to the computer, then use Ctrl+V there. Receiving text does not overwrite the phone clipboard until you press Copy to phone.
Sent. Use Ctrl+V on the computer to paste.
Received. You can now copy this text to the phone.
No plain text is available in that clipboard.
The text is invalid or too long (maximum 32,768 UTF-16 units).
Clipboard request timed out. Try again after a moment, or reconnect.
The computer clipboard changed during the request. Please try again.
The text clipboard channel is not ready or was disabled by the computer. Try again after connecting.

Trackpad: slide one finger to move the pointer; tap to click. Double tap and drag, or arm Drag, to hold the left button. Tap Trackpad to switch to Direct touch, where the finger position is the target. In either mode, tap with two fingers for right click, move two fingers together to scroll, and pinch to zoom up to 5×. Switch Scroll to Move canvas to pan. The percentage restores Fit. Tools contains shortcuts and a manual text clipboard.
Enter the Windows account password, not a PIN. Remembered credentials are encrypted on this phone after a successful connection. Sessions are retained in the background for up to 60 seconds.
The session ended after 60 seconds in the background. Reconnect to continue.
The device identity or mesh connection changed. Reconnect after checking the network.
Saved credentials could not be read or updated. Please enter them again or try forgetting them.
Network unavailable. Waiting for a connection (up to 60 seconds)…
Connection interrupted. Reconnecting securely (up to 60 seconds)…
Could not restore the connection within 60 seconds. Check the network and reconnect.
Data saver: 960 × 540, 16-bit, up to 15 fps. Balanced: 1280 × 720, up to 30 fps. Sharp: 1920 × 1080, up to 60 fps. Applies on connection; the computer may negotiate a different format.
Compatible graphics · software decoding. Frame rates are presentation limits and depend on the computer and network.
The computer did not provide a desktop within 30 seconds. Check that it is awake and remote desktop is enabled, then reconnect.
Uses H.264 on supported phones with Balanced or Sharp. If unavailable or decoding fails, the connection uses compatible graphics. Applies on the next connection.
